text:
Aisha: FYI — incoming guest (gallery rep) at 2:10 with a 6ft art panel and a projector case. They said it's fragile and needs a signature on arrival.
Front Desk: Logged — delivery scheduled. We have a visitor badge printed but the RFID chip isn't pairing with the reader.
deliveries-bot: Delivery logged (ID: DEL-4821). Expected courier ETA 14:05. Please confirm acceptance flow.
Jon: Uh oh, RFID again? @Front Desk did we try reseating the antenna on the badge printer? Last week fixed it with a tap :grimacing:
Front Desk: Tried reseat, still not pairing. Printer shows `OK` but scanner returns `ERR:RFID_NO_BIND`.
Front Desk: Short-term: we've printed a paper badge and will escort the guest upstairs. Can someone meet them at the stairwell? :raising_hand:
Maya: I can grab them — I'll be free at 2:12. Do we need them to sign any NDAs? The rep said 'quick paperwork'.
Aisha: Yes — we sent an NDA link pre-visit but they didn't fill it. Please have them sign on the iPad at the desk. If they refuse, we can do a visitor-limited badge.
Liam: Quick heads-up — art panel too tall for elevator, so stair escort required. @Zara can you clear the 3rd-floor hallway for the demo setup at 2:20?
Zara: On it. I'll move the rolling carts and reserve the window couch for the demo audience. Poll: Couch or high-tables? React :couch: for couch, :coffee: for tables.
Jon: :couch: (also bring extra moving blankets)
Front Desk: Noted. Badge workaround: temporary badge `GUEST-4821-PAPER` marked escort-required, expires in 90 mins. Log snippet:
```
SCAN LOG: GUEST-4821-PAPER assigned to Aisha escort_required=true
RFID_SCAN: fail -> manual_entry_allowed
```
Aisha: Thanks — everyone, thanks for the quick cleanup. @Front Desk add a note about projector power draw (they need 20A outlet near the window).
Front Desk: Added note. All set — ping if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
